cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Be Right in Retrospect
cards.instruction: Perform certainty by reinterpreting every surprise as something your earlier words were obviously predicting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. When I said the evening would flow, I meant this kitchen flood.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Water is now the dominant topic. A remarkably accurate forecast.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You didn't predict a burst pipe.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I said we'd need to open up. The plumbing listened first.

mechanism: A corrects its former hosting pupil literal memory by claiming earlier flow and opening-up remarks predicted the surprise kitchen flood.
confusable: Not arranging failure on purpose: A claims accurate foresight through reinterpretation of prior wording, without saying it caused the burst pipe.
comparison: Social-flow phrase reinterpreted as water versus sunny packing advice reinterpreted as refund mood.
seedUse: D234 flow/conversation/flood/burst/open up; S05 listening to hints.
